paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: The plot displays the distribution of polarity scores for vaccine-related sentiments, with the x-axis representing polarity scores ranging from -1.0 to 0.6 on a linear scale, marked at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis shows the corresponding counts, ranging from 0 to 50,000 on a linear scale, with major tick marks at intervals of 10,000. A single blue line with circular markers connects data points, illustrating the frequency of each polarity score. The counts remain low and relatively flat from -1.0 to approximately -0.4, increasing gradually to around 10,000 at -0.2. There is a sharp rise to a peak of approximately 50,000 at a polarity score of 0.0, followed by a steep decline to about 17,000 at 0.2. The counts then drop to around 8,000 at 0.4 before rising again to approximately 10,000 at 0.6. The overall trend indicates a strong concentration of sentiments near neutral polarity (around 0.0), with fewer sentiments at both negative and positive extremes.
